fixes.explanation: Yes, baker! When Pashhur releases Jeremiah from the stocks, Jeremiah says to him, "The LORD does not call you Pashhur, but Magor-missabib." (Jeremiah 20:3). That's a new name straight from the LORD. Jeremiah just spent a night in the stocks, and he still has the LORD's word to deliver.

Hiding the treasure is a clever plan, friend, but it's not the one the LORD gives. He says He will give the wealth of the city to their enemies, who will plunder it, seize it and carry it off to Babylon (Jeremiah 20:5). Burying it under the temple isn't in these verses. What the LORD describes is the treasure being carried off.
